chunks: 5644 - And in the narration of Yūnus, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū Baṣīr, he said: I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:
Regarding six brothers and a grandfather, he said: “The grandfather receives one-seventh.”

key_terms.جَدٍّ: grandfather; a paternal ascendant considered in inheritance law
key_terms.سِتَّةِ إِخْوَةٍ: six brothers as heirs in an inheritance case
key_terms.لِلْجَدِّ السُّبُعُ: the grandfather’s share is one-seventh of the estate

ai.seo_question: What is the grandfather’s share of inheritance when there are six brothers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in the law of inheritance concerning a case involving six brothers and a grandfather. It states that the grandfather’s fixed share in this scenario is one-seventh of the estate.
